title: Stop Saying "Very Quiet"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very quiet". Use one of these words instead:
• Silent: a silent classroom
• Hushed: in a hushed voice
• Peaceful: a peaceful morning
• Soft-spoken: a soft-spoken teacher
• Tranquil: a tranquil lake
